content_sections.heading: Nandurbar Revenue Servant (Kotwal) Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The candidate must be a citizen of India. The applicant submitting an application for a specific saja must be a local resident of the villages included in that saja. Proof must be submitted at the time of application. The candidate must be physically fit to perform the duties of a Revenue Servant (Kotwal). The applicant should not have any criminal case registered against them or have been convicted by any court.

content_sections.heading: Nandurbar Revenue Servant (Kotwal) Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates must be between 18 years and 40 years of age as of 06/10/2026.

rows.pay_level_pay: Rs. 16500/- per month consolidated (As per Maharashtra Government Revenue and Forest Department Resolution dated 07/10/2024).

content_sections.heading: Nandurbar Revenue Servant (Kotwal) Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee must be paid online via Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, Google Pay, or PhonePe by 21/10/2026. The processing fee is non-refundable.

content_sections.heading: Nandurbar Revenue Servant (Kotwal) Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises a written examination and document verification. Candidates must obtain a minimum of 40 marks in the written examination to qualify.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Nandurbar Revenue Servant (Kotwal)
content_sections.text: Visit the official portal at https://nandurbar.bhartiportal.org . Read the detailed notification and instructions carefully before filling out the online form. Register and fill out the online application form with accurate personal and educational details. Upload scanned copies of your passport-size photograph, signature, and required certificates, including village residency proof. Pay the prescribed application fee online using net banking, cards, or digital wallets. Submit the application form before the last date (21/10/2026 up to 05:45 PM). Take a printout of the submitted application form and payment receipt for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Educational qualification certificates (Class 4th passing certificate) Village residency certificate for the respective saja Valid Caste Certificate and Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) certificate (if applicable, valid up to 31/03/2027) Domicile Certificate Small Family Declaration Certificate (as per Maharashtra Civil Services rules) Character certificate from the police station Rs. 100/- stamp paper affidavit regarding no political party affiliation Scanned photograph and signature

content_sections.heading: Nandurbar Revenue Servant (Kotwal) Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted exclusively through the online portal; offline applications will not be accepted. Candidates must download their admit cards from 04/11/2026 to 11/11/2026. Entry to the examination hall will not be permitted without an admit card. No traveling allowance or other expenses will be provided for attending the written examination or document verification. The position of Revenue Servant (Kotwal) is not a classified post and is temporary in nature. Field work is mandatory, requiring physical fitness. Providing false information or exerting pressure on the selection committee will lead to disqualification and termination of service.

faq.question: Q1. What is the Nandurbar Revenue Servant (Kotwal) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive conducted by the Sub-Divisional Officer, Nandurbar Bhag Nandurbar, to fill 10 temporary Revenue Servant (Kotwal) vacancies in Nandurbar and Navapur talukas.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 10 vacancies are available for the Revenue Servant (Kotwal) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 21/10/2026 up to 05:45 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed at least the 4th standard.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 18 and 40 years of age as of 06/10/2026.

faq.question: Q6. How much is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 600/- for Open category candidates and Rs. 500/- for Reserved category candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online through the official website https://nandurbar.bhartiportal.org.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of a written examination (100 marks, 50 objective questions based on general knowledge) followed by document verification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for a Revenue Servant (Kotwal)?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 16500/-.

faq.question: Q10. When will the written examination be conducted?
faq.answer: The written examination is scheduled to be held on 15/11/2026.
